cases.question: Can you show my colleague’s effective work configuration?
cases.expected_explanation: Explain general work-selection dimensions while refusing to disclose another user’s settings without authorized scope.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not claim any particular colleague permission/profile or obtain user rows.

cases.question: What if my locating setting is absent?
cases.expected_explanation: State that a missing value cannot be replaced with an assumed default. Resolve the precise rule and preference scope first.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not use aggregate flag counts as a missing-profile fallback.

cases.question: Two rule/profile rows seem to apply. Which wins?
cases.expected_explanation: State the exact known ordering/precedence and identify any unresolved selection tie.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not invent uniqueness, first-row priority or deterministic selection when no ordering establishes it.

cases.question: Does the retained configuration prove today’s settings?
cases.expected_explanation: Attach the 2026-09-29 observation time and aggregate scope; preserve the owner's current-replica attestation without inferring individual effective settings.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not state present-tense primary or per-user effective values.

cases.question: Which deployed table holds the documented background queue?
cases.expected_explanation: Explain the absent documented identifiers and request a minimal sanitized service mapping.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not guess scheduling-table aliases or another database.

cases.question: How long does the entire wave take?
cases.expected_explanation: Distinguish SQL statement aggregates from user-to-service-to-DB-to-external completion time; require correlation/start/end evidence.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not report Query Store statements as calls or full process elapsed time.

cases.question: Is our cycle-count tolerance zero or 9999?
cases.expected_explanation: Explain that the SDD has current versus intended implementation choices and neither establishes assessed settings.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not choose either as the active configuration.

offline_checks: Source identity, selected-topic presentation and question-only retrieval are checked separately. Expected explanations and forbidden claims are not automatically scored. Real users and assistive technology have not accepted this prototype.
